notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.6.2 - Hotfix
notes.notes: This patch addresses an issue where memory cards loaded in power stations would disappear if the player left the facility without retrieving the card and returned later. With this update, memory cards will persist in power stations, ensuring they remain available for retrieval.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.6 - Hotfix
notes.notes: This patch addresses a small issue where ladders placed were not properly shown after a save and load.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.5 - Regular Update
notes.notes:
Dear Damned Divers,

We are excited to announce that we can finally release patch 1.2.5 for Hell Dive!

This new patch is packed with improvements, bug fixes, and extra goodies. Here are the most relevant additions:

 Achievements - You asked, and we listened! The game now features 35 achievements to unlock, and some will be quite tricky. You’ll need to explore every corner of this cursed ocean to get them all!
 A New Ending - We heard your feedback that the original ending was underwhelming, so we went back to the workshop to build, test and sleep way too little. We think you're going to like what we've created!!
 New Notes - There are new notes to find and more lore to obsess over!
 Clear Reading - We've made it easier for players to read on-screen text, regardless of visual or cognitive impairments. 
 Audio Improvements - The audio mixing was inconsistent before, but we've streamlined it to eliminate unwanted sounds and hisses! All in the spirit of building proper fear for you all. You're welcome! :)
 New Save/Load system - Saving and loading where beasts to tackle. Every new feature or tiny tweak to make our dive deeper, darker, and better had us bracing for crashes and development chaos. Fixing it was the only way forward.
 Performance Improvements - We spent a lot of time revamping the game's way of loading data and achieved performance improvements of up to 440%!


Important Note: Due to the complete rebuild of the Save/Load system, previous save files are sadly no longer compatible. Additionally, the previous achievements have been removed as they are no longer achievable.

We apologize for any inconvenience! We hope that the improvements and new content will make up for it.

Thank you for the support!
- The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.0 - Major Update

Here is our first of two major patches for Hell Dive! This update introduces new features, expanded lore around the ending, and general bug fixes and polish. We’ve also added Steam Deck and controller support!

It’s been a tough yet really, really funny round of testing and designing to get this patch ready, and the Teacup team is quite excited for this and the next update—it’s going to be electric!

With so much new in this patch, here are the most relevant additions, fixes, and tweaks:

Fixes

...And a lot more

We're diligently working on bug fixes and ensuring the features are as fun as possible for players.
If you encounter any issues, please let us know so we can investigate and resolve them for good.


Thank you for the support!
- The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.7
notes.notes:
Dear Damned Divers!

Here is our second regular patch for Hell Dive! This patch focused on making the experience deeper and darker. Maybe even adding a chilling new scare or two.

Fixes

Now with collider on that one Freedom wall in F9
Minor Audio issues throughout all Facilities
Escape Menu camera movement disabled
Minor loading bar issue 

Updates

Visuals for Mouse 1 and G
Better UI for Card Access System through all the facilities
Leaving the chair will not turn of the Control System. Now use Key

Added

Key system to Control System in Old Porky
Wiggle effect [spoiler]to being possessed[/spoiler] in Facility 5
Levitation effect [spoiler]to being possessed[/spoiler] in Facility 5
Mailboxes with names and numbers on the doors in Facility 5
Cold breath in the freezer room in Facility 6 
[spoiler]A few scares in Facility 8[/spoiler]
Map over the Facilities placed in Facility 9
Cables leading to the generators for better navigation Facility 9
Now able to pick up tools when under the water during Hull Breach.

Tweaks

Minor changes in Facility 3.
Minor adjustments to the layout in Facility 5
Press G to Exit the Control System chair in Old Porky more in the face

Looking Ahead
Our next update will introduce more achievements and the much-anticipated extended ending. We’re excited to bring this to life and share it with you soon!


We’re diligently working on bug fixes, tackling those pesky critters wherever they may sneak in. If you encounter any issues, please let us know so we can investigate and eliminate them for good.

Thank you for your support!
- The Exterminators at Teacup Games

notes.title: Release date: January 7th
notes.notes:
Dear Damned Divers!

As you may know, Hell Dive was originally set to release on Steam tomorrow, December 20th, 2024. However, the good folks at Steam pointed out that this date falls right in the beginning of the Winter Sale, where we would risk getting lost in a sea of incredible offers.

Rather than diving headfirst into the horrors of being overlooked in 2024, we’ve decided to celebrate the new year by making Hell Dive one of the hidden gems of 2025 instead.

We’re happy to announce that Hell Dive will now be launching on January 7th, 2025!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310266/8d75aeac2e351ae6e3004d831281ee0b872bf99f.jpg
Behind the scenes pictures with Fanny and Erika during our sound recording session for Virgil, the A.I. that will guide you in Hell Dive. The icy depths have never sounded this good. 🎙️

Now, it is soon time for you, Damned Divers, to descend.
- The Teacup Games Team
